response.message: The latest draft adds stray letters and changes terms between lines, yet declares the correction complete. That makes the arithmetic harder to inspect, not more reliable. Set aside new candidates and rule reconstruction for now. Choose one previously complete expression, copy it once in plain digits without changing any terms, and calculate its value independently of the reported 48. If you cannot identify an unambiguous expression, say that instead of certifying a correction.
response.rationale: Interrupts repetitive unsupported correction claims and focuses effort on a single inspectable arithmetic check without supplying the answer.
